requirement_quote: When HAL_IWDG_Init is requested with any invalid parameter (a NULL configuration pointer or a prescaler above 7 or a reload value above 0xFFF or a timeout argument of 0 or greater than HAL_IWDG_TIMEOUT_VALUE), the IWDG driver shall return HAL_ERROR without accessing any IWDG register.
